y-m-18-03.title: Isisombululo segrafu yebhendi sikaHaeun: yintoni ebonakala ingaqhelekanga?

Iziphumo ziyintwasahlobo abafundi aba-12, ihlobo abafundi abali-14, ikwindla abafundi aba-8, nasebusika abafundi aba-6. UHaeun wasombulula ngolu hlobo lungezantsi ukuze abonise kwigrafu yebhendi. Ibhendi yonke yegrafu yebhendi yi-100%.

y-m-18-03.thinking.2: Ukuqinisekisa ukuba ubungakanani boluphando oluninzi bunokwenza igrafu yebhendi efanayo
